intro.text: An Idrian slumlord in T'Telir, one of the most powerful among the city's Idrian exiles, who runs an illegal boxing ring.

items.text: Denth arranges a hard-won meeting between Vivenna and three powerful Idrian slumlords, Ashu among them. Ashu doubts that war is coming at all and cares only about what it would mean for him. As Vivenna rises to go, disgusted, he calls the whole thing a waste of time; then Lifeless sent by the city watch attack, and he flees.

appearance.text: He wears fine, brightly coloured clothes, as T'Telir's wealthy do, but keeps his hair long, against the fashion of the Hallandren upper class. He holds at least fifty Breaths, enough for the First Heightening.
